component: Button variants (primary, destructive) and async action button
need: Distinguish the one primary action per view and destructive actions (Revoke, Void) in application UI; show in-progress state on submit without double submission.
workaround_r1: Use native button with text labels; confirm destructive actions via dialog (G-005); disable the button and show operation-status while pending. Acceptable for design; not for production visual hierarchy.
acceptance: data-forma-variant=primary|destructive styles exist in components.css outside the marketing scope; an aria-busy button state is styled and announced; axe passes.

component: Field invalid, disabled and read-only styling
need: Forms must show invalid fields and read-only policy values distinctly (G-012).
workaround_r1: validation-message text plus aria-invalid; the visual distinction relies on adjacent message text only.
acceptance: :disabled, :read-only, [aria-invalid=true] and :user-invalid styles exist in foundations.css with 3:1 non-text contrast; a browser test proves each.

component: Data table styling for plain table
need: Not required by release-1 designs: data-grid and dense-ledger cover all tables.
Not required by release 1: the exception inbox has no bulk actions by design (each decision is individual). One-click batch approval (RCD-005) is a single dialog listing items.

component: Visualization primitives and chart accessibility contract
need: Trend views for sponsor overview and investment performance (post release 1).
acceptance: A chart primitive with a mandatory text-table equivalent and axe-tested contrast.

component: Letter primitives (letterhead, address block, signature block)
workaround_r1: Compose from ef-print-header and ef-print-section with semantic address and paragraph markup (proven in design prototype D-001).
acceptance: Documented recipe or primitives with print-position rules for window envelopes (address block at a fixed position).

component: Verification code and document identity block
need: Each issued document shows its reference and a verification code or URL that resolves in the document registry (REQ-X-034).
workaround_r1: Text verification code inside ef-print-footer; QR code generation is Unbound-owned (SVG).
acceptance: Footer shows the reference and the verification URL; the registry resolves the hash.

component: Deterministic server-side PDF rendering (P2) and batch generation
need: Monthly statements for every fund, re-renderable byte-for-byte or with a stable content hash.
workaround_r1: Headless Chromium print-to-PDF from the Folio HTML; determinism measured on the page-content hash, because PDF metadata dates vary (see report 17).
acceptance: Re-rendering the same snapshot yields an identical normalized content hash; throughput is measured.

component: Widget host, frame protocol and scoped tokens
workaround_r1: Plain iframe with server-issued short-lived token; no postMessage commands in release 1.
acceptance: CSP frame-ancestors restricted to registered partner origins; token TTL ≤ 10 minutes; no PII beyond the card.
